content.rationale:
Four prerequisites claim one act - where a draft's workspace is created (lpkssxpp), what one opening call does over its argument list (vnwmpwrx), what a call naming no node is answered with (xzrkrmmr), and the record as Quint state (tvtnokzu) - and none of them models the act itself. `specs/drafts/open.qnt` is that model: module `draft_open`, one step per opening call, in the house form of `specs/markers/undo.qnt` and `specs/markers/scope.qnt`, importing `draft_state` from `./state` rather than restating a record. It steps the registry's own variable (`records`) and nothing else, because opening writes a record and no graph: no node, edit or marker is written by the step, and the state module's variable set is the whole of what a step can change.

The action `open` is one call's effect held at once, because vnwmpwrx fixes one opening for a call and not a draft at a time. Its first argument is the surface's list read as namings: `nodes` is a `List[str]`, so a node named twice occupies two positions and yields two drafts, which is how vnwmpwrx's `counting a node named twice as two` is carried - the model never folds the list into its distinct names, and never refuses a name (what a call does when an id names nothing is outside vnwmpwrx, so nothing here constrains the names). `edit` is the one edit the call names, the surface's optional edit position read as a value, and every record the call files carries it: one edit per invocation, so one edit across the call's records. The record's edit field is `str` in the registry's form (tvtnokzu), so how an absent edit is spelled is the record's question and not restated here.

One record per name, none skipped and none written twice, is enforced rather than described: `handles`, `workspaces` and `bases` are `List`s whose lengths must equal `nodes.length()`, and the new registry is built by folding over `nodes.indices()`, filing at position i under `handles[i]` the record `filed(handles[i], nodes[i], edit, workspaces[i], bases[i])`. A list positioned against the name list cannot skip a name (no position is left unfiled) and cannot write one twice (one position, one entry); the lengths are guards and not decoration, so a call claiming fewer values than names is not this action. Filing is a key-inserting write, not an assignment at a key the registry must already hold: the fold uses `acc.put(handles[i], ...)`, which adds the handle, where the module's first draft used `acc.set(...)`. vnwmpwrx has the call write records, and `Map::set` - like `Map::setBy` - raises on an absent key, so a fold built on it files nothing from the registry's empty initial map: the action cannot step at all, and `one record per name` would hold only of the term that never runs. `Map::put` inserts, and the freshness guards above (every handle absent from the registry, the call's handles pairwise distinct) mean an insert never replaces a filed record, so the action steps from `Map()` and each name's record is written exactly once. That is the amended gate's added fact read at the record write - the one record per name must be a record the action actually writes - and it is the whole of the change: the operator, nothing else in the module or the record. The map is built by the state module's own constructor, so `state` is `Open` - the first value yuomrusm fixes and the only state a draft that has landed nothing can hold - the handle is the key the record sits under (kwqnrzoz), the `node` field is the name at that position, and the `workspace` and `base` fields are the record form's own (kwqnrzoz, qrqsxyzz). The fold is over a set of indices, and its order cannot show because the handles are distinct, so no ordering rule is smuggled in through the fold.

A handle keys exactly one record (kwqnrzoz, rqtowtqn), so `open` requires every handle it files under to be absent from the registry and the call's handles to be pairwise distinct: a fresh handle per record, no filed record overwritten, and no two of the call's records collapsed into one. Minting is not modelled - how a handle is generated stays the opening's rule per tvtnokzu - only the uniqueness the registry's key imposes.

Each draft's workspace is its own, carried by the record through the reference the record form fixes (`Workspace = { name, path }`, kwqnrzoz), and the model enforces it as a fact about paths: no two records filed by one call share a path, and no path a new record takes is already held by a filed record. lpkssxpp fixes the place from the record's handle, and a handle is unique per record, so two drafts never hold one place; the model cannot derive a path from a handle without inventing the derivation, so it carries the consequence - distinct places - rather than the formula. The workspace's `name` is fixed by no prerequisite to be unique (vnwmpwrx leaves the jj name of a workspace unfixed), so it is deliberately left free: what must be distinct is the place, not its spelling, and requiring distinct names would add a rule nothing fixes.

Each record's base is a value the call supplies and the record keeps: a `str -> Identity` read once at filing, keyed by repo-relative path, with `Identity` the registry's opaque content identity (qrqsxyzz, carried by tvtnokzu). The model asserts nothing about how the identity is computed, which paths the owned set holds, or when it is read - those are qrqsxyzz's and its siblings' - and because nothing in the module or in `draft_state` re-reads a base, a draft's base is the one it was opened against.

The empty call is its own action, `openNone`, and it is a stuttering step: `records' = records`. xzrkrmmr places the refusal at the argument surface, before any workspace or record exists, so the refused call must leave no record and no workspace behind - and a stutter leaves exactly that. It is not `open` with an enabling guard, because both effects and the refusal would then be one action's, and it carries no state guard (unlike `undoEmpty`, which can read a position) because nothing in the registry witnesses a call's emptiness: the emptiness is the call's, not the state's, and any state guard would refuse a call xzrkrmmr does not refuse. `open`'s own `nodes.length() > 0` is the same placement read from the other side: a call the surface refuses never reaches the opening, so it is not this action.

Deliberately outside the module, each carrying its own commitment: where a draft's workspace is created and how the path is derived (lpkssxpp names the place, not the computation); the record's document, its filename and its untracked directory (nolspvpw, rqtowtqn); minting a handle; the landing and the state move it performs (yuomrusm, in `draft_state`); the stale comparison and its refusal (qrqsxyzz's rule over a run); the CLI surface itself (szvotxpq, vnwmpwrx, xzrkrmmr) and the report a call prints, which is the record's own handle and workspace path read back and changes no state; and the step assembly with the invariants a checker would run, which belongs to a sibling check module in the form of `specs/markers/check.qnt` and to which this unit's write set licenses no path. The module is the opening's effect and nothing more: it fixes what one call writes and what an empty call leaves untouched, and states no verdict about itself.
